description: A static `<md>` inside an `<each>` row renders per row with the row's value as text (never markdown) and the soft line break kept as text; a row added later renders the same way.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F1 "a" (`${…}` inside `<md>` is TEXT-ONLY)
rationale: §67.4: an atom's value is text; §67.3: a soft line break is a line end inside a paragraph (text). The row's `${@.name}` holding `**a**` shows the asterisks.
